payload.intro: My mind is slipping... tell me, quickly!
payload.prompt: How many doses does a newly made potion hold?

payload.intro: Please, I desperately need aid on the road! I always repay a kindness... before I flee.
payload.prompt: What does Dr Jekyll give you for a clean Torstol?

payload.intro: I must crush these dragon scales into fine powder!
payload.prompt: Which two-piece tool does every herbalist use to grind ingredients into dust?

payload.intro: Please, quickly. I need an Antifire potion to steady myself before I transform into Hyde.
payload.prompt: Which secondary ingredient goes into a Lantadyme potion (unf) to make an Antifire potion?

payload.intro: I need to stay nimble and clear-headed before I lose myself to that brute Hyde.
payload.prompt: Which secondary ingredient turns a Toadflax potion (unf) into an Agility potion?

payload.intro: I feel Hyde trying to force his way out, you must hurry!
payload.prompt: Which secondary ingredient is needed to brew a Super defence potion?

payload.intro: My notes are scattered everywhere! Help me pair each clean herb with the potion it brews before my hands start shaking!
payload.prompt: Match each primary herb to the potion it is used to make.
payload.explanation: Ranarr makes Prayer potions, toadflax makes Saradomin brews, snapdragon makes Super restores, kwuarm makes Super strength and cadantine makes Super defence.

payload.intro: A proper apothecary cleans their herbs in order of potency. Don't touch the Torstol until you're ready!
payload.prompt: Order these grimy herbs by the Herblore level required to clean them, from lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Guam requires level 3, ranarr 25, avantoe 48, snapdragon 59, dwarf weed 70 and torstol 75.

payload.intro: One vial to unite all three melee brews! Tell me everything that goes into a Super combat potion!
payload.prompt: Which four ingredients are combined to make a 4-dose Super combat potion?
payload.explanation: At level 90 Herblore, a clean torstol (or unfinished torstol potion) is combined with 4-dose Super attack, Super strength and Super defence potions.

payload.intro: Liquid golden sunshine in a vial... if only I had the skill to mix crushed bird nests with toadflax myself!
payload.prompt: What Herblore level is required to make a Saradomin brew?
payload.explanation: Saradomin brews require level 81 Herblore and grant 180 experience per potion.

payload.intro: Decanting hundreds of vials by hand is madness! Go see the fellow at the Grand Exchange who does it in the blink of an eye.
payload.prompt: Which NPC at the Grand Exchange decants your potions into any dose you ask for?
payload.explanation: Bob Barter stands in the south-west corner of the Grand Exchange and decants noted or unnoted potions for free.

payload.intro: With a few amylase crystals dissolved in a Super energy potion, I could outrun Mr Hyde for minutes!
payload.prompt: How many minutes does the run-energy drain reduction from one dose of Stamina potion last?
payload.explanation: One dose of Stamina potion restores 20% run energy and reduces run energy depletion by 70% for 2 minutes.

payload.intro: Have you visited the alchemists in Aldarin? They break every herb down into three strange pastes!
payload.prompt: Sort these herbs by the type of paste they refine into at Mastering Mixology.
payload.explanation: Low-tier herbs like guam and marrentill refine into Mox paste, mid-tier herbs like irit and cadantine into Aga paste, and high-tier herbs like ranarr and snapdragon into Lye paste.
